products.catalogRule: One product model, two colorways (not two separate SKUs).

promptLock.silhouette: Women's flat Mary Jane with rounded toe and single instep strap
promptLock.upper: Ribbed knit fabric; vertical ribs on toe box; ribs follow contour on sides
promptLock.strap: Single Mary Jane strap across instep; denser woven/seed-stitch texture than body; matching plastic buckle on outer side (round or small square)
promptLock.heelCollar: Smooth padded collar at heel — BLACK colorway uses BLACK collar matching exterior (not tan); beige colorway uses tonal tan/beige collar

branding.layout: Ornate crown above decorative crest; stacked serif MODEL / MATCH; small year banner (e.g. 1982)

sole.forefoot: Grid of small four-petal floral/clover grips (beige colorway) or checkered grid (black)

mustNot: Blank insole when top-down / open view
